'''Yuko Sanpei''' (Japanese: '''三瓶由布子''' ''Sanpei Yūko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Sanpei was born on February 28, 1986, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. As an adult, she became a voice actress and landed a number of prominent roles in anime series since. In {{aniseries|PTS}}, she first voiced [[Thomas]], a [[character of the day]] who appeared in {{aniseries|DP}}. Sanpei then voiced her best-known role in ''Pokémon the Series'', who was also named [[Sanpei]], during {{aniseries|XY}}. She was initially affiliated with the talent agency Gekidan Wakakusa, but left in May 2007 to freelance. Six months later, she joined {{wp|Production Baobab}}. At some point, Sanpei joined Axl-One and won the Best Leading Actress Award during the {{wp|13th Seiyu Awards}} of 2019. She is married with two children.
